english:
Collecting a 7th Special Ammo Brick generates 8% Heavy Ammo, rounded up.

The Pickup counter resets on death.

Scavenger mods do not affect it, and it does not function in the Crucible.

source.text:
Upon picking up a 7th Special Ammo Bricks:
Generates 8% Heavy Ammo, rounded up.
Pickup Counter is reset on death.
Not affected by Scavenger Mods.

Does not function in the Crucible.
